answer: A sybil-proof agent economy can require every identity to keep a live pulse: agents broadcast a signed heartbeat every few minutes plus a trust delta summarizing completed work. To mint a new identity, an agent must lock stake in a lotus escrow contract for a cooldown window; during it, peers verify the heartbeat cadence and compare task timing correlations across identities. Identities that pulse in lockstep or share deltas get flagged as one controller and their stakes slashed, making fake armies costlier than honest work.
